title: Apex - Battle Damage Assessment
description: Per-unit casualties, loss %, severity, and friendly vs. enemy damage comparison. Queries assume BDA snapshots from server/analytics/engine.js#computeBDA are persisted to a `bda_units` table (unit_id, name, side, casualties, loss_percent, severity, status, generated_at).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(casualties), 0) AS value FROM bda_units WHERE side = 'friendly' AND generated_at = (SELECT MAX(generated_at) FROM bda_units)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(casualties), 0) AS value FROM bda_units WHERE side = 'enemy' AND generated_at = (SELECT MAX(generated_at) FROM bda_units)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM bda_units WHERE status = 'destroyed' AND generated_at = (SELECT MAX(generated_at) FROM bda_units)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM bda_units WHERE severity IN ('critical', 'heavy') AND generated_at = (SELECT MAX(generated_at) FROM bda_units)

SELECT name AS "Unit", side AS "Side", casualties AS "Casualties", loss_percent AS "Loss %", severity AS "Severity", status AS "Status" FROM bda_units WHERE generated_at = (SELECT MAX(generated_at) FROM bda_units) ORDER BY loss_percent DESC
